text:
Liam (Finance Ops): FYI reseller 'CloudTrailz' reported duplicated seat usage in Azure marketplace export for July. System bug duplicated activations during a bulk invite. Need retro credit + breakdown for partner settlement.

Sofia (Partner Ops): Oof. Do we have the export lines? which SKUs affected? reseller wants a single consolidated credit, but accounting needs line-level detail.

Liam (Finance Ops): Paste of suspect rows from marketplace CSV:

```
subscription_id,sku,seat_count,unit_price
sub_b4c9,azure-team-seat,450,10.00
sub_b4c9,azure-team-seat,450,10.00
```

There are two identical rows for the same subscription and period. Net overcharge = 450 seats * $10 = $4,500 before fees/withholdings.

Devon (Revenue Ops): Confirming: this is an over-report (duplicate) not an actual increase, right? We'll do a credit memo for $4,500 gross. Also need to account for partner commission/withholding. Contract says reseller commission is 20% of gross; marketplace withholding 10% applies on refunds.

Nina (Accounting): For a $4.5k credit: we need approval chain + GL reversal lines. Please include original invoice ref and marketplace settlement id. Also note tax treatment: Azure reports VAT withheld at source for certain EMEA resellers — check tax flag.

Sofia (Partner Ops): Original invoice: inv_20240731_CTZ.pdf. Settlement id: AZ-MKT-987654. I'll ask partner to sign an acceptance that this was a reporting error to avoid churn claims.

Billing Bot: Created ticket FIN-4901: "AZ reseller duplicate seat overreport - CloudTrailz". Assigned to @nina and @liam.

Liam (Finance Ops): Proposal: issue credit memo for $4,500 gross, book partner commission reversal of $900 (20%), and withhold marketplace fee on refund of $450 (10%). Net customer credit: $4,500 - $450 = $4,050. Net revenue impact: reverse $4,500, then reapply commission reversal. Accounting to confirm lines.

Nina (Accounting): Need JEs: 1) Reverse recognized revenue (Sales) $4,500 DR; 2) Accrued partner commission reversal $900 CR to Commission Expense; 3) Record payable for withheld marketplace fee $450 CR to Marketplace Fee Payable. Please prepare credit memo PDF + note for audit.

Devon (Revenue Ops): I'm comfortable with that flow. Nina, do you need additional backup?

Nina (Accounting): Yes attach marketplace CSV, original invoice, and partner signed confirmation. Also include tax code; if VAT applies, we may need a separate VAT adjustment line.

Sofia (Partner Ops): Reaching out to partner now. Draft acceptance note: "We confirm duplicated seat entries on July marketplace export were caused by our bulk-invite process and request a refund/credit of $4,050 net after marketplace withholding." Will attach signed PDF to FIN-4901 once received. :email:

Liam (Finance Ops): Once partner signs, I'll generate credit memo in Netsuite and tag FIN-4901. Timeline: aiming to post before next settlement run to avoid manual cash movement.

Billing Bot: Updated FIN-4901 with status "awaiting partner signoff".

Devon (Revenue Ops): Flag for revenue ops: mark subscription sub_b4c9 as "investigate" to prevent repeated duplicate billing. @eng-sre we may need a fix.

Sofia (Partner Ops): Noted. I'll coordinate with eng and partner success.

Liam (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone. Will update thread when credit memo posted. :white_check_mark:
